fields.System.Title: Create document with review and approval
fields.System.Description:
As a process owner, I want to be enabled automatic creation of a document through a stage defined process with options for subsequent review and approval of same document

Details:

1. Component Identity

Proposed Name: Create documment with review and approval
Originating Process: N/A
Author: MJ
Date:

One-Sentence Description:
Creates a new outbound document and sends it for approval and review

2. Business Intent

Describe the business situation where this building block is used.

  • Trigger event:
  • Intended outcome: Outbound document created, reviewed and approved
  • primary actors involved: Case worker

Do not describe implementation steps. Describe purpose.

3. Functional Behavior (Explicit Sequence Required)

Describe the expected flow in ordered steps.

For each step, use the following structure:

Step 1 – Create Document

  • Purpose: create new outbound document
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Document archive —Configurable. Default: Outbound
    • Document  category — Configurable , Category: Create Document
    • Recipient  - configurable  default : Applicant role on case,  Category: Create Document
    • Document title:  configurable.  Category: Create Document
    • Document template:  configurable Category: Create Document
  •  Milestones to trigger
    • configurable set as argument
  • Mandatory or Optional: Mandatory
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action
  • Completion condition:  document created, 

Step 2 –send for review 

  • Purpose: Send the document from step 1 in review
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Document ID - fetched from step 1. Category: SendForReview
    • Optional  Yes no Do Review  Yes/No Category: SendForReview
  • Mandatory or Optional: Optional
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action  
  • Completion condition: Document sent for review


Step 3 –Send for approval

  • Purpose: Send the document from step 1 in approval
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Document ID - fetched from step 1.  Category: SendForApproval
  • Mandatory or Optional: Optional
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action
  • Completion condition: Document sent for review


Step 4 –Dispatch

  • Purpose: Send the document from step 1 in review
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Document ID - fetched from step 1. Category: DocuementDispatch
  • Mandatory or Optional: Optional
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action
  • Completion condition: Document sent for review

Step 5 –Register date  - Milestone 1

  • Purpose: Register date of first milestone
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Milestone, from code table: Milestone type Category: DocuementMilestone
    • Action title: Text. used for the title in the task in the progress plan Category: DocuementMilestone
  • Mandatory or Optional: Optional
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action (milestone update)
  • Completion condition: Milestone status updated.

Proposed Name: Announcement 
Originating Process: N/A

Describe the business situation where this building block is used.

  • Trigger event:
  • Intended outcome: Outbound document created, reviewed and approved
  • primary actors involved: Case worker

Do not describe implementation steps. Describe purpose.


3. Functional Behavior (Explicit Sequence Required)

This process consists of 3 blocks: Create new document, create email, register milestone.

We will first define the building blocks, and then specify the sequence of these


Block 1 – Create Document - with subsequent review, apprval and dispatch

  • Purpose: create new outbound document
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Document archive —Configurable. Default: Outbound, Category: Document

    • Recipient  - configurable  default : Applicant role on case,  Category: Create Document
    • Document title:  configurable.  Category: Create Document
    • Document template:  configurable Category: Create Document
    • create review::boolean, configurable Category: Create Document
    • create approval:  boolean, configurable Category: Create Document
    • Create dispatch boolean, configurable Category: Create Document

  • Mandatory or Optional: Mandatory
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action
  • Completion condition:  document created,, review, approval and dispatch attatched

Block 2: Create email:

Invokes first the attachment and recipient selector, and then opens the new email dialogue in Outlook

Arguments / Parameters:
  • Show recipients  boolean, configurable Category: Create Email
  • Show Attatchments  - boolean, configurable Category: Create Email
  • Activity title, text, configurable Category: Create Email

Block 3  –Register date  - Milestone 

  • Purpose: Register date of first milestone
  • Arguments / Parameters:
    • Milestone, from code table: Milestone type Category: DocuementMilestone
    • Action title: Text. used for the title in the task in the progress plan Category: DocuementMilestone
  • Mandatory or Optional: Optional
  • Client action, server action or other: Client action (milestone update)
  • Completion condition: Milestone status updated.



The sequence in the process will be:

1: Create new document
2: Create e-mail
3: Create new document

6: Create new document
7: Create e-mail
8: Create new document
9: Create e-mail

fields.System.Title: Analysis/Code Changes
IFAR - Redaction - Enable flattening for PDF forms and emails - Hotfix 6.8
Alert when connections in setup are not allowed
fields.System.Description:
There are a lot of connections in PAF, for instance milestone, contacts, document categories etc. that are used in a process, but also needs to be allowed on the chosen case type/document archive etc. 

For instance when setting up case roles in the template, you get all case roles in the codetable, but not all of them are connected to all case types. So in this case the four yellow ones are only connected to case type Case, but the process model is going to be connected to case type Konsesjonssak. If then the template is set up with some of the yellow contact roles, they will not be allowed on the actual case type, and there should be a clear message in admin stating that there is a missing connection here. So that the one configuring can either add the roles to the case type, or choose another role. 

This goes for all places where this kind of connections occur.
